findings.title: Duplicate ignore rule adds no coverage
findings.description: The `.notes/` pattern is already present at line 23, so this second copy changes no ignore behavior and leaves a redundant rule to maintain. Remove the added duplicate; the existing rule already ignores the notes folder.

findings.title: Odd-dimension padding has no regression coverage
findings.description: Neither re-encoding command has a test that runs it with odd-sized video and verifies the resulting dimensions are even (or that even dimensions are unchanged). A filter typo or removal would therefore let both the voice-replacement and normalization paths regress without detection, which is the behavior this change is meant to fix.

findings.quote:
<button class="link" onclick={async () => {
					if (isTauri()) {
						const { invoke } = await import('@tauri-apps/api/core');
						await invoke('plugin:shell|open', { path: driveLink });
					} else {
						window.open(driveLink, '_blank');
					}
				}}>{driveLink}</button>
findings.title: Drive link opening paths have no regression coverage
findings.description: There are no tests for the new button behavior in either runtime. A regression in the Tauri shell invocation or the browser's new-tab behavior would go unnoticed; cover both branches and verify each receives the displayed Drive URL.
